featured_reviews.name: Jessie Hannah
featured_reviews.review_text: I was referred to Sahyog by a close friend. A loving member of my family was diagnosed with early Parkinson’s with Dementia. Jennet was patient, kind and so caring & supportive. She organized a day visit, made a house call for a personalized assessment and welcomed my loved one with integrity and compassion. Whilst there, he was tended to, included and made to feel part of a family. The place is green and calming, the staff considerate and friendly. It’s a care home and whilst no one ever really wants to leave their loved ones, sometimes situations and circumstances leave us no choice. But I would choose this place again as it really does deliver on its CARE. Thank you Jennet and your team 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Sheldon Aranjo
featured_reviews.review_text: We first got to know of Sahyog ~3 years ago when my uncle urgently required 247 care as he had collapsed in public spaces on more than one occasion. After calling about a dozen old age homes and being rudely shocked by the "donations" expected or the inconvenient locations, we chanced upon an ad in the examiner by Sahyog and immediately went over to book a place for our uncle, When we surveyed the place we were first taken aback by the greenery and serene atmosphere. It has a HUGE Chappel and many swings and benches for elders to sit and enjoy oneness with nature. My uncle spent 2 beautiful years at Sahyog, helping with the community activities, chatting with his sons in NZ and keeping jovial before he passed on. Since then I have gotten to know the management and staff really well. Sister Jennet is the rock that holds it all together. She is a sister in the medical parlance not faith. Mr. Simon Martin the founder is a well known social worker and writer who helps relocate tribals and give them opportunities to upskill and earn a living. Kudos to Sahyog for delivering quality senior care at an affordable price. Highly recommend them to kids who want to give their seniors the best but are unable to because of family circumstances.
